g.title: MarieRank4Convo3 begins.
g.text: MarieRank4Convo3 begins.

g.title: j3237991959
g.text: How are you today, Marie?

g.title: j242691715
g.text: [End.]

g.title: j903995915
g.text: I am not so grand. You may wish to come back to talk to me tomorrow. I will not be the best of company.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j1117189926
g.text: I'll go if you want, but if you want to talk, I'm happy to listen.

g.title: j1061218029
g.text: All right, I understand.

g.title: j620749039
g.text: May I ask what's wrong...?

g.title: j2849293606
g.text: C'est vraiment gentil, but it is an old problem... nothing worth troubling yourself over. I will be fine.

g.title: j3096270068
g.text: Boolean MarieChronicPain is now true.

g.title: j1922354112
g.text: If you're certain, but I'm here, if you want to talk about it.

g.title: j228031770
g.text: I... know what that's like. Before I started "looping," I hurt myself pretty badly in Duviri. It healed, but it still aches something awful from time to time. I try to hide my wincing when it acts up.

g.title: j3319601858
g.text: Old persistent problems can sometimes be as problematic as new ones. Just because they come and go, and can stay with us, doesn't mean they aren't worth talking about.

g.title: j1830509044
g.text: You are so very kind, and... very well. I am being little stubborn Marie again.

g.title: j2462064003
g.text: Boolean DrifterChronicPain is now true.

g.title: j1341992207
g.text: Oui, tu as raison. I am being little stubborn Marie again.

g.title: j2082867706
g.text: It is a hard thing to explain, but I will try. Mes pieds, oui ? My feet. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -

g.title: j1175286619
g.text: Par les Luminaires, I am so very sorry. You understand then, what it is like, oui ?

g.title: j220342261
g.text: But I still feel them, those twisted things that threatened to consume me, threatened to crush all hope and joie from my soul.

g.title: j1277997961
g.text: To have a body that betrays you, that slows your spirit down. Even now, it is so strange. The sérum has changed me, given me flight -

g.title: j3605592873
g.text: Always they hurt. Always. Even now, as I sit here, if I think of them, I feel the pain. But it is not always enough that I notice.

g.title: j1273941105
g.text: Still, now, they wake me wake in the night from aching. And I wonder, Sol, pourquoi ? Why must I still feel this... agonie interminable ?

g.title: j650744778
g.text: What purpose does it serve ? Ah, but then the morning comes, and I laugh, and tell myself, "be quiet, Marie, you are blessed. Look at all you have, all that you can do."

g.title: j463885706
g.text: At the Cathédrale it was "You can read, you can write, you can eat, you can sleep. You can move about well enough. You have eyes to see and a tongue to speak. Hands with which to write. Those who care for you." And now, I can fly! I can protect the futur from the Void itself. From l'Indifférence !

g.title: j2556094749
g.text: "Weep now, silly girl, this constant pain will make you strong against what will come," I tell myself. And the day moves into another and it is not as bad when the next one comes.

g.title: j830269311
g.text: Check boolean DrifterChronicPain

g.title: j3664390562
g.text: If there's one thing it's given us, it's a tolerance for pain, I suppose.

g.title: j830269311->j3664390562
g.text: true

g.title: j1729070591
g.text: Sometimes, though... I wake up and I feel like it's going to be the day that I break.

g.title: j830269311->j1729070591
g.text: true

g.title: j3167138288
g.text: It... really never stops hurting? I'm so, so sorry, Marie...

g.title: j830269311->j3167138288
g.text: false

g.title: j3166559163
g.text: And there's no medication? No treatment?

g.title: j830269311->j3166559163
g.text: false

g.title: j1202818303
g.text: A parishioner once asked me, "you are in pain? Always?" To which I replied, "Oui, monsieur. Je le suis." His look of astonishment was mixed with horror.

g.title: j2669236699
g.text: Sometimes, I used to sit and think of how much I could do if I were not in so much agonie, oui ? If I were not so... trapped in a cage of flesh that was so set upon hindering me at every turn.

g.title: j2582561051
g.text: Would I wish there was. Mais non, there is not. Not in my time, and I fear likely not in this one.

g.title: j4230389936
g.text: "How do you go on?" was his next question. And I remember I smiled to him and replied "What is my other choice, Monsieur...?"

g.title: j3402355506
g.text: How furious it would make me ! How jealous I would become of those whose bodies were not born a betrayal to them. But what good does it do us in the end, à part rendre nos vies plus amères ? More embittered ?

g.title: j2852949631
g.text: Some ailments are beyond the cures of man, science, and faith.

g.title: j1929618145
g.text: I have had that same conversation so many times...

g.title: j2994940671
g.text: Exactly. I'm so sorry.

g.title: j438597550
g.text: Aucun. I am how I am, and I shall persevere.

g.title: j3702378120
g.text: Non, I am simply sorry you have shared in such a similar agonie.

g.title: j2980398560
g.text: Check boolean DrifterChronicPain

g.title: j141758109
g.text: And so shall you. So shall you. In this, I have faith.

g.title: j2980398560->j141758109
g.text: true

g.title: j3293865693
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2980398560->j3293865693
g.text: false

g.title: j2816280445
g.text: I cannot put into words how much this conversation has meant to me. So I will simply say merci, Drifter.

g.title: j3563974437
g.text: Et encore merci.
